mapper.select:
SELECT emp03_person_id AS person_id, emp01_kor_nm AS person_name, org02_kor_nm AS org_name FROM emp03_trans INNER JOIN emp01_person ON emp01_person_id = emp03_person_id INNER JOIN ( SELECT * FROM org01_code INNER JOIN org02_info ON org02_code_id = org01_code_id WHERE org01_company_id = #{companyId} AND (org02_code_id, org02_mod_date) IN ( SELECT org02_code_id, MAX(org02_mod_date) FROM org02_info WHERE org02_mod_date <= #{stdDate} GROUP BY org02_code_id ) ) org ON org01_code_id = emp03_org_code_id WHERE emp01_company_id = #{companyId} AND (emp03_person_id, emp03_trans_date) IN ( SELECT emp03_person_id, MAX(emp03_trans_date) FROM emp03_trans INNER JOIN emp01_person ON emp01_person_id = emp03_person_id WHERE emp01_company_id = #{companyId} AND emp03_trans_date <= #{stdDate} GROUP BY emp03_person_id ) AND emp03_trans_cd NOT IN ('800','900') /*(800:겸직 / 900:퇴직)*/ AND COALESCE(emp03_non_stay_yn,'false') != 'true' AND emp03_title_cd != '900' /*(900:비상근)*/ AND emp03_kind_cd NOT IN ('40','99') /*(40:임시직/99:기타직)*/
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM emp33_except_biz WHERE emp33_company_id = emp01_company_id AND emp33_person_id = emp01_person_id AND #{stdDate}::date BETWEEN emp33_start_date AND COALESCE(emp33_close_date,'2999-12-31'::date) AND emp33_except_biz_cd = #{exceptBizCode} AND COALESCE(emp33_unvisible_yn,'false') = 'true' )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ics31_compliance_write WHERE ics31_company_id = emp01_company_id AND ics31_person_id = emp01_person_id AND ics31_yyyymm = TO_CHAR(#{stdDate}::date, 'YYYY.MM') AND ics31_cycle_type = #{cycleType} AND ics31_confirmer_id = #{confirmerId} )
ORDER BY COALESCE(org02_sort_order, org01_org_cd) , f_code_seq(emp01_company_id, 'EmpTitleCode', emp03_title_cd) , f_code_seq(emp01_company_id, 'EmpPosCode' , emp03_pos_cd) , emp01_emp_no
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys99_print ( sys99_print_id, sys99_company_id, sys99_person_id, sys99_window_class_nm, sys99_group_id , sys99_long01, sys99_long02, sys99_string01, sys99_string02, sys99_date01, sys99_date02 , sys99_string05, sys99_string06, sys99_string07, sys99_text01 ) VALUES ( #{printId}, #{companyId}, #{personId}, #{windowClassName}, #{groupId} , #{row.seq}, #{row.personId}, #{row.personName}, #{row.orgName}, #{stdDate}, #{startDate} , #{row.complianceType}, #{row.complianceTypeName}, #{row.complianceResult}, #{row.reason} )
mapper.select: WITH sys_code AS ( SELECT a.* FROM sys08_code_kind INNER JOIN sys09_code a ON sys09_code_kind_id = sys08_code_kind_id WHERE sys08_kind_cd = #{kindCode} AND sys09_company_id = #{companyId} AND sys09_apply_date = ( SELECT MAX(b.sys09_apply_date) FROM sys09_code b WHERE b.sys09_code_kind_id = a.sys09_code_kind_id AND b.sys09_company_id = a.sys09_company_id AND b.sys09_code = a.sys09_code AND b.sys09_apply_date <= #{stdDate} ) AND ( ( COALESCE(sys09_close_yn,'false') = 'true' AND COALESCE(sys09_close_date,'1900-12-31') >= #{stdDate} ) OR ( COALESCE(sys09_close_yn,'false') != 'true' ) ) ) SELECT sys09_code AS compliance_type, sys09_name AS compliance_type_name, f_get_compliance_result(#{personId}, #{stdDate}, #{cycleType}, ics30_compliance_type, ics30_start_date) AS compliance_result, ics30_start_date AS start_date FROM ics30_compliance INNER JOIN sys_code ON sys09_code = ics30_compliance_type WHERE ics30_company_id = #{companyId} AND ics30_start_date = ( SELECT MAX(ics30_start_date) FROM ics30_compliance WHERE ics30_company_id = #{companyId} AND ics30_start_date <= #{stdDate} AND COALESCE(ics30_date_fix_yn,'false') = 'true' ) AND ( ( ics30_use_yn = 'false' AND ics30_use_close_date >= #{stdDate} ) OR ( ics30_use_yn != 'false' ) ) GROUP BY ics30_compliance_type, ics30_start_date, sys09_code, sys09_name, sys09_seq ORDER BY LPAD(sys09_seq,5,'0')
